name: doccheck
description: Agent that cross-checks freight documents (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, ISF) before customs entry in Canada and the US.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @doccheck/schemas -w @doccheck/rules -w @doccheck/extraction -w @doccheck/synth -w @doccheck/regulations -w @doccheck/agent && npm run build -w @doccheck/api -w @doccheck/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @doccheck/schemas -w @doccheck/rules -w @doccheck/extraction -w @doccheck/regulations && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.corpus:index: npm run build -w @doccheck/regulations && node packages/regulations/dist/cli.js index
